conventions.convention: Backgrounds are oriented, time-oriented smooth Lorentzian four-manifolds without boundary, Hausdorff and second-countable, with signature (-,+,+,+). Global hyperbolicity means strong causality and compact point causal diamonds.

P=-□g+V with arbitrary smooth real V. E+ is retarded with future support; E− is advanced with past support. Test functions are real and carry the locally convex inductive-limit topology transported through the positive metric density.
E=E−−E+ and σ([f],[h])=∫f(Eh)μg on V(M)=C_c∞(M;R)/P C_c∞(M;R). Nondegeneracy is algebraic; surjectivity onto all spacelike-compact solutions is not asserted.

The Weyl algebra consists of finite formal sums, with W(v)W(w)=exp(-iσ(v,w)/2)W(v+w) and W(v)*=W(-v). Local algebras have no norm closure. Admissible embeddings have open causally convex image and intertwine P on compact tests.
Nonselective expectations sum every branch of a finite normalized bounded Kraus family. The conclusion assumes elementwise commutation and makes no apparatus-realization claim.
The Bell-pair example uses an inner product linear in its first argument; vector expectations are ⟨Cψ,ψ⟩. Conditional vectors are defined only for positive branch weights.

load_bearing.statement: Assume Countable Choice and Dependent Choice. For the stated smooth globally hyperbolic background and arbitrary smooth real potential, every compact smooth Cauchy datum and compact smooth source admit a unique global smooth solution, with the stated one-sided metric causal support and fixed-support derivative estimates. For every Cauchy set Σ and point q, J−(q)∩J+(Σ) and its time reverse are compact. Zero smooth data on any smooth spacelike Cauchy hypersurface imply a homogeneous solution vanishes, without a support hypothesis.

A Green-data interface consists of continuous real-linear retarded and advanced maps satisfying PE±f=E±Pf=f and the respective future/past support conditions, together with uniqueness of the smooth homogeneous Cauchy problem.

Assume Countable Choice and a Green-data interface. Then E C_c∞(M;R) is contained in Sol_sc(M), ker E=P C_c∞(M;R), and σ([f],[h])=∫f(Eh)μg is a well-defined nondegenerate real alternating bilinear form on V(M).
Assume Countable Choice and the geometric hypotheses of the Green-data definition. For compact K,L, every closed subset of J+(K)∩J−(L) is compact; this does not assume J±(K) themselves are closed.
Assume Countable Choice and Dependent Choice. For a Cauchy morphism ι:U→M between the stated Green-data backgrounds, every f∈D_g(M) has g∈D_g(U) with [f]=[ι*g] in V(M).

Assume Countable Choice. An admissible Green-background morphism induces a well-defined real symplectic quotient map and a unital Weyl *-homomorphism preserving identity, composition and the stated local-algebra inclusions.
Assume Countable Choice and Dependent Choice and a Green-data background. The algebraic local Weyl algebras are isotone, and algebras of causally disjoint open sets commute elementwise.

concerns.concern: F3 attributes to lem-manifold-bump-for-a-compact-set-inside-an-open-set a bump 'with compact support in O'. The supplier Statement guarantees support contained in O, without compactness; its proof likewise selects bumps without imposing compact support. Step 1.2 needs a compactly supported cutoff. The gap closes by first enclosing C in a relatively compact open neighborhood W with closure contained in O, then applying the supplier to W. The same stronger attribution appears in lem-qftx-free-weyl-functoriality F6 and step 1.2.

F2 cites only def-compact-space for finite subcovers, while step 2.1 applies compactness directly to ambient open covers of K and L. That definition explicitly fixes intrinsic subspace compactness and requires citing lem-compactness-of-a-subspace-is-ambient for the ambient formulation. The missing justification is elementary restriction of the ambient cover to the compact subspace; add that derivation or the exact supplier.

seams_checked.note: The actual logical use is def-qftx-distributions-on-smooth-manifolds. Its absolute-Jacobian density rule and finest locally convex fixed-support inductive-limit topology match the Green-interface construction and Green-existence continuity argument. The consumer uses real tests through the metric density. No wavefront-product, Hadamard or star-product conclusion is imported through this page prerequisite, and the supplier page has no reciprocal dependence on local algebras.
